title: Department of City Planning report, findings, and proposed interim control ordinance relative to prohibiting the issuance of any construction, alteration,…
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S10; CD 14]
Department of City Planning report, findings, and proposed interim control ordinance relative to prohibiting the issuance of any construction, alteration, remodel, addition, expansion, restoration or building, change of use, use of land, or other applicable permits, approvals, or certificates of occupancy, including any utility service connection, re-energization, or distributed-generation interconnection approval for large cold storage warehousing and distribution uses on all light industrial, industrial, and hybrid industrial zoned properties within the Boyle Heights Community Plan area; and adoption of project findings. (This item is referred to the Ad Hoc Committee for Boyle Heights Fire Recovery and Planning and Land Use Management Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
